opportunities.title: EIP-7702 Didn't Cause the $6.3B Binance Hack — It Just Made the Blast Radius Bigger

opportunities.angle: Security postmortem: explain EIP-7702 batched transactions in plain terms, map it to the attack chain, and note which wallets/devs flagged this risk months ago.

opportunities.title: The Company Hired to Track Hackers Just Got Hacked by One
opportunities.why_now: Chainalysis — crypto's premier investigator — disclosed a breach using 'offensive agentic techniques' days after the Binance hack it's now investigating.
opportunities.angle: Irony-driven security analysis: what 'agentic' attack techniques mean, why even forensics firms are targets, and what it implies about AI-assisted offense outpacing AI-assisted defense.

opportunities.title: Your Hardware Wallet Might Already Be Compromised — Before You Even Opened the Box

opportunities.angle: Actionable security explainer: how to verify hardware wallet authenticity, why reseller purchases are the risk, checklist for buyers.

opportunities.title: Binance's $6.3B Bailout Is the Best Argument Against Binance

opportunities.angle: Opinion/analysis: centralized exchanges are 'too big to fail' crypto banks now; lay out what this means for self-custody advocates who called this exact outcome.

opportunities.title: The FBI Just Asked DeFi to Freeze Addresses — Watch Who Says Yes

opportunities.angle: Tracker/scorecard format: list major DeFi protocols, whether they've complied, and what it reveals about the gap between decentralization marketing and decentralization reality.
